BL-1351 — Every /events frame carries the entire backlog including 1200 closed tickets, so one connect costs 6.7 MB and every backlog commit costs it again per client
What it solves: ## Verified at mint
Approval context: One question, about shape rather than whether the defect is real. The 6764293-byte measurement is from a live hold test either way.
OPTION 1, which the ticket is written for, keeps the stream's shape exactly as consumers see it today and only narrows each item to the fields something actually reads…
BL-1351 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1351" (or "reject BL-1351 <reason>") to act.
